speaker: Patient
text: 74-year-old male. The patient presents with sudden onset of abdominal pain around the umbilicus 16 hours ago, with recent history of hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction a week ago. Reports several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements. Denies vomiting.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Ischemic Colitis. Given the patient's recent myocardial infarction and presentation of bloody loose bowel movements with periumbilical pain, this is highly suggestive of bowel ischemia. I am requesting a CT Abdomen/Pelvis with contrast and a stool study for occult blood to confirm the diagnosis.
